svg.title: M1 expansion connector pinout
svg.desc: Straight-on enlarged view of the 18-pin expansion connector strip on the top edge, 86 mm long, with pin numbers and signal names. Pin 1 is at the right, pin 18 at the left.

g.text: TOP EDGE - device front toward viewer, left end of device at left
pin 1 at right end | strip 86.0 x 9.5 mm | pitch 3.43 mm
